title: Find max of three nos using Ternary Operator

content.problemStatement: Write a Program to find max of three nos using Ternary Operator

solution.approach: Process inputs via standard stream input and apply required transformations.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    parts = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not parts: return
    a, b, c = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])
    print(a if (a >= b and a >= c) else (b if b >= c else c))
if __name__ == '__main__': main()
